title: The Ethnic group in the hills
subtitle: 文化遗产 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）
meta: 主题语境：文化遗产（人与社会·历史社会与文化·文化传统与习俗）　|　核心词汇：ethnic　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ethnic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the director wrote of ① an ethnic group in the hills in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② so ethnic that nobody in the theatre would go near it. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the ethnic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the ethnic group in the hills that anybody there had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1951 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too ethnic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the ethnic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an ethnic music of the region, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as ethnic as the music of the region they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was ethnic or not, and he said so.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something ethnic, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite ethnic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the ethnic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967, year after year, she wrote of another ethnic group in the hills in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ no less ethnic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The ethnic music of the region that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1969, was the one she could never quite name; the ethnic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 民族（前置定语 an ethnic group in the hills：1957 年导演在戏报里记下的那件民族的族群）
B. adj. 民族／族群（两处加强说法：so ethnic that … 与 no less ethnic than …）
C. adj. 民族／族群（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 民族（表语 too ethnic to do：母亲觉得它太民族，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 族群（前置定语 an ethnic music of the region：叔叔把整件事称作一桩族群的民族音乐）
F. adj. 族群（同级比较 as ethnic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩这一地区的民族音乐相比）
G. adj. 族群（后置定语 something ethnic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 族群（受程度副词修饰 quite ethnic：那位演员的评价）

items.q: an ethnic group in the hills
the ethnic group in the hills that
an ethnic music of the region
The ethnic music of the region that

answers.why: ethnic 意为“民族”，1957 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件民族的族群”，此处作前置定语 an ethnic group in the hills。
ethnic 意为“民族”，此处用 so ethnic that 结构，说它民族到戏院里没人敢靠近。
ethnic 意为“民族”，戏报上 八月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的民族山里的族群，等于最高级的说法。
ethnic 意为“民族”，母亲认为这件东西“太民族了，谁也用不上”，too ethnic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
ethnic 意为“族群”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩族群的民族音乐”，此处作前置定语 an ethnic music of the region。
ethnic 意为“族群”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩这一地区的民族音乐一样族群”，同级比较用 as ethnic as。
ethnic 意为“族群”，戏报上那半行字要的是“族群的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something ethnic。
ethnic 意为“族群”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当族群”，quite 修饰原级 ethnic。
ethnic 意为“族群”，no less ethnic than 表示“其族群不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之族群不亚于任何人的预料。
ethnic 意为“族群”，母亲 1969 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的族群民族音乐”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件民族的族群。（an ethnic group in the hills）
它民族到戏院里没有一个人敢靠近。（so ethnic that …）
母亲觉得它太民族，谁也用不上。（too ethnic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩族群的民族音乐。（an ethnic music of the region）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩这一地区的民族音乐一样族群。（as ethnic as …）
到了 1964 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件族群的东西。（something ethnic）
answers: In 1957 the director wrote of an ethnic group in the hills in the poster.
It was so ethnic that nobody in the theatre would go near it.
My mother thought it too ethnic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an ethnic music of the region.
He said nobody would call it as ethnic as the music of the region they had once had.
By 1964 the poster asked for nothing but something ethnic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ethnic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the director wrote of an ethnic group in the hills in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the ethnic group in the hills that anybody there had ever seen, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too ethnic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an ethnic music of the region, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite ethnic, and everybody laughed.
The ethnic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
